title: Config Platform
description: A lightweight, standards-first configuration platform supporting multi-tenant and multi-project configuration with offline-first and remote-first patterns. Published as @jewel998/config on npm.

title: State Machine
description: A lightweight, type-safe stateless state machine library for JavaScript/TypeScript. Zero per-object overhead, async transactions with database rollbacks, middleware pipeline system, and scales to millions of objects efficiently.

title: Portfolio Website
description: Personal portfolio website built with React, TanStack Router, Tailwind CSS v4, i18n support via Lingui, and Motion animations. Features theme transitions via View Transitions API.

title: Lyrics Synchronized Music Player
description: A web-based music playlist application with real-time lyrics synchronization, timestamped lyrics parsing, playback control, and dynamic highlighting.

title: Comparison of Time-Series Forecasting Models
description: Compared time-series forecasting models including AR, ARMA, ARIMA, ARMAX, SVR, KRR, and SMOReg, evaluating performance on real datasets using RMSE and MAE as key metrics.

title: HACK36 2020 Website
description: Official website for HACK36 2020, a national-level hackathon by MNNIT Allahabad. Responsive design with modern UI patterns and animations.
